hook.name: AerodromeClassicAggregator v1.2
hook.description: Aggregator hook that fills Uniswap v4 swaps from Aerodrome Classic volatile pools, returning a BeforeSwapDelta so the v4 pool itself holds no liquidity. The input is settled from the PoolManager inside beforeSwap, so only exact-input swaps are supported. Liquidity provision on the v4 pool is disabled, the hook is immutable and ownerless, and a protocol fee capped by a constant is taken on each swap.
